say:3:1120306001:1.text: What's going on? A powerful mage, accompanied by some young Uru Clan warriors...
say:3:1120306001:1.source_cn: 啊呀，乌尔氏族的年轻勇者们，还有这位厉害的魔法师……
say:3:1120306001:1.male: What's going on? A powerful mage, accompanied by some young Uru Clan warriors...
say:3:1120306001:1.female: What's going on? A powerful mage, accompanied by some young Uru Clan warriors...

say:4:1120306002:1.text: What brings you to my arena today?
say:4:1120306002:1.source_cn: 是什么风把你们给吹来了？

say:5:1120306003:1.text: We're looking for your meerkat friend, Mikola. It's urgent, so can you help us?
say:5:1120306003:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉，我们有急事要找狐獴。你能帮帮我们吗？

say:6:1120306004:1.text: More specifically, the one who sold illicit potions before saving Alsa.
say:6:1120306004:1.source_cn: 就是之前贩卖非法药剂，后来又救了阿尔萨那位。

say:7:1120306005:1.text: ...So you're looking for Smokey, eh? Sorry, but I promised that I wouldn't disclose his location without his consent.
say:7:1120306005:1.source_cn: ……你们想要找阿熏啊。但很可惜，我答应过他，不会擅自透...

say:8:1120306006:1.text: As you all know, Smokey's made no shortage of enemies in his life. Plenty of people would love to get revenge on him for his past deeds.
say:8:1120306006:1.source_cn: 你们知道的，阿熏曾经做过一些不好的勾当，多多少少有些仇人。

say:9:1120306007:1.text: His own safety is his highest concern... So I can't tell you where he is right now. Sorry.
say:9:1120306007:1.source_cn: 他很在意自己的安全……所以很抱歉，我不能告诉你们他的藏身地。

say:10:1120306008:1.text: I swear, Mikola, we're only looking for him because we desperately need his help. We won't share his whereabouts with anyone else!
say:10:1120306008:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉，我发誓，我们找他真的只是想要寻求帮助，而且我们...

say:11:1120306009:1.text: A young Mauler in the Uru Clan is gravely ill, and none of the herbs I've tried have worked on him.
say:11:1120306009:1.source_cn: 乌尔氏族有个小蛮血生了重病，我试了所有的草药，都没有用处。

say:12:1120306010:1.text: Since Smokey saved me from that dagger's poison back at the Warsong Festival, I thought he might be able to save this little boy too...
say:12:1120306010:1.source_cn: 听说之前我被毒匕首刺伤那次就是阿熏救了我。我想，应该只...

choice_prompt:13:1120306010.text: Since Smokey saved me from that dagger's poison back at the Warsong Festival, I thought he might be able to save this little boy too...
choice_prompt:13:1120306010.source_cn: 听说之前我被毒匕首刺伤那次就是阿熏救了我。我想，应该只有他能治好那孩子了……

say:14:1120306011:1.text: Fine, I'll make an exception for you since it's an emergency. After all, you're the victors of the Warsong Festival...
say:14:1120306011:1.source_cn: ……好吧，既然话都说到这份上了，你们又是战歌节的胜利者……

say:16:1120306013:1.text: I'll give you Smokey's location, but only under one condition—
say:16:1120306013:1.source_cn: 我会把阿熏的地址告诉你们。但有一个条件——

say:17:1120306014:1.text: If you do manage to find him, he can't know that I was the one who gave up his secret. He's the type to hold a grudge for a very long time.
say:17:1120306014:1.source_cn: 如果你们成功找到阿熏的话，不要和他说地址是我透露的。那...

say:18:1120306015:1.text: Thanks, Mikola! And don't worry, we'll keep our lips sealed for sure!
say:18:1120306015:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，曼卡拉！我们一定会守口如瓶的！

say:19:1120306016:1.text: Don't mention it, but like I said, that meerkat takes his own safety more seriously than anything else...
say:19:1120306016:1.source_cn: 不客气。不过，就像我刚刚说的那样，阿熏是非常在意自身安...

say:20:1120306017:1.text: Even with his location in hand, finding Smokey will still be a challenge.
say:20:1120306017:1.source_cn: 所以即使有我给的地址，要找到他本人，你们应该还得费一番功夫。

choice:13:0:1.text: His life hangs in the balance.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 没错，事情关乎到一条性命
choice:13:0:1.male: His life hangs in the balance.
choice:13:0:1.female: His life hangs in the balance.

choice:13:1:2.text: We really need your help right now.
choice:13:1:2.male: We really need your help right now.
choice:13:1:2.female: We really need your help right now.
